label: Small business, only a bank statement: words
aliases: small business, only a bank statement: w

params.name: title
params.default: Where did the money come from?
params.label: title

params.name: lede
params.default: This is what your bank statement says. Money paid by customers is your business turnover. Your own money moving between your accounts, loans and refunds are not. We have guessed each one - tap to change.
params.label: lede

params.name: recon_ok
params.default: The statement adds up: opening {opening} + credits {credits} - debits {debits} = closing {closing}.
params.label: recon ok

params.name: recon_bad
params.default: This statement does not add up, so its figures are not used. Upload the original PDF again (all pages) from net banking.
params.label: recon bad

params.name: f_through
params.default: An equal amount went out within {days} days - is this a loan or own money passing through?
params.label: f through

params.name: f_round
params.default: Round amounts - is this a customer?
params.label: f round

params.name: sum_cash
params.default: Cash takings (deposits you say are fees)
params.label: sum cash

params.name: line
params.default: Turnover {digital} received by UPI or bank at {rd}% = {p6}, cash {cash} at {rc}% = {p8}. Presumptive profit under s.44AD: {profit}.
params.label: line

params.name: line_none
params.default: No customer receipts counted yet - tap the groups that are your customers.
params.label: line none

params.name: line_rule
params.default: s.44AD: {rd}% of the turnover received through a bank or UPI, {rc}% of cash; loans, own money and refunds are not turnover.
params.label: line rule

params.name: res_regime
params.default: {regime} regime - the cheaper one is chosen for you on the next steps.
params.label: res regime

params.name: res_nil
params.default: No income tax - the income is below the basic exemption.
params.label: res nil

params.name: contact_p
params.default: Type what is missing - nothing else is asked.
params.label: contact p

params.name: undecided
params.default: {n} groups worth {amount} are not decided and are left out of your turnover. Tap what they are.
params.label: undecided

params.name: interest
params.default: Interest of {amount} on your savings is income from other sources - it is added for you.
params.label: interest

params.name: salary
params.default: Salary credits of {amount} found - these are not business turnover. Give the Form 16 so the salary can be added.
params.label: salary

params.name: gst_over
params.default: Your turnover of {turnover} is above {limit}, the GST registration limit for a {supply} supplier (s.22 CGST Act). You may have to register for GST - ask a GST practitioner. This does not change the income-tax return.
params.label: gst over

params.name: gst_near
params.default: Your turnover of {turnover} is close to the GST registration limit of {limit}. Above it you must register for GST.
params.label: gst near

params.name: need_code
params.default: What the business does (the department's code)
params.label: need code

params.name: need_ok
params.default: Nothing more is needed - the JSON is ready on the last step.
params.label: need ok

params.name: late
params.default: Filed after the due date of {due}: late fee under s.234F {fee} and interest under s.234A, 234B and 234C {interest} are in the amount to pay.
params.label: late

params.name: code_p
params.default: The department wants one code for the work. The common ones are first.
params.label: code p

params.name: upload_h
params.default: How to upload the JSON on the income-tax portal
params.label: upload h

params.name: upload_p
params.default: Takes about five minutes. You need your PAN, password and mobile (for the OTP).
params.label: upload p

params.name: path_label
params.default: Small business - only a bank statement
params.label: path label

params.name: path_sub
params.default: No books, no Form 16 - the bank statement alone makes an ITR-4 (tax on a fixed share of receipts)
params.label: path sub

params.name: debit_note
params.default: Presumptive tax: costs are not claimed, so money out does not change the tax. It is shown for completeness.
params.label: debit note

description_nl: 2026-10-13: Every word of the Classify step (customer receipts, own money, loan, not income), the 6% / 8% line, the GST limit warning, what is still needed, and how to upload the JSON on the income-tax portal.
